input: Zuva rakanyura mujinga mejengachenga, richipenya mumigwagwa yeguta yaiva nevanhu vakawanda. Vanhu vakaita chipatapata vachitevedza migwagwa, tsoka dzavo dzichiita maungira panzira apo nhaurirano dzakanga dzava kugunun'una. Mumakofi, kunhuhwirira kwekofi ichangobva kubikwa yakasanganiswa nehwema hwezvinhu zvakabikwa, zvichikoka vapfuuri kuti vambomira uye vazvinakidze. Vatambi vemumugwagwa vakawedzera kurira kwemutinhimira uye mutinhimira, vachishandura guta racho kuita runyararo rweruzha uye ruvara. Manheru paakanga ava kugadzikana, marambi eguta akapenya kuupenyu, achivheneka kutamba kwakaoma kunzwisisa kwehupenyu hwemudhorobha husina kumbomira zvechokwadi.

Mhiri kwenzvimbo yakakura yezvikomo nemasango akasvibira, mhepo yaizevezera zvakavanzika mumashizha. Mhuka dzemusango dzakamhanya-mhanya pasi pedenga, kufamba kwadzo bhora rakanyarara richiitwa pasi peziso redenga. Rukova rwaifamba zvishoma nezvishoma munzvimbo iyi, pamusoro parwo rwairatidza kupenya kwezuva uye kugadzira mapeni aipenya aifadza ziso. Shiri dzaiimba nziyo dzaiita sedzairondedzera nyaya yezvakasikwa, mutsindo woupenyu wainzwika mukunyarara. Mumamiriro ezvinhu aya akadzikama, nguva yaiita seinononoka, ichibvumira nguva dzekufungisisa nerunyararo kuti dzibudirire.

Mukati meraibhurari huru, masherufu akatambanudzwa asingagumi, akazadzwa namabhuku echidzidzo chiri chose chaungafungidzira. Hwema hwemapepa ekuchembera uye zvisungo zvedehwe zvakazadza mhepo, zvichikoka vaongorori veruzivo kuti vaongorore munyika dzisingaverengeki. Vaverengi vaigara munzvimbo dzakadzikama uye pamatafura akatambanudzwa, maziso avo achiongorora mapeji apo pfungwa dzavo dzaidzungaira nepfungwa, nyaya, uye zvavakawana. Pano neapo, ruzha rwaipenengura mapeji rwairatidza ruzha rwekunyatsoisa pfungwa pachinhu chimwe. Kunze, nyika yakapfuuridzira kumhanya kwayo, asi mukati meaya masvingo, chisiko chapose pose chouchenjeri nokufungidzira chakabudirira mukunyarara kunotsinhirana.

Pamusika wakabatikana, vatengesi vaishevedzera zvinopiwa zvavo, vachirwira ngwariro pakati pemanzwi akawanda. Matanga akazara nemichero inoyevedza, zvinonhuhwirira, uye micheka ine mavara, chimwe nechimwe chichitaura nyaya yekwakabva uye unyanzvi. Vatengi vakanetsana pamusoro pemitengo uye vachinjana nyaya, vachigadzira tapestry ine upenyu yekubatana kwevanhu. Kunhuhwirira kwenyama yakagochwa uye makeke anotapira ainzwika mumhepo, zvichiita kuti vaipfuura vafarire. Mukati memhirizhonga, paive nerwiyo rwepasi - kupuruzira kwaiita kuti musika urambe uri mupenyu uye uine simba, humbowo hwekutsungirira kwenharaunda.

Mugungwa guru, masaisai airovera pamusoro pechikepe chengarava, achitumira mvura yemunyu mumhepo. Vashandi vaifamba vaine chinangwa, vachigadzirisa maseiri uye kufamba nemunzvimbo huru yebhuruu, vachitungamirirwa chete nenyeredzi uye intuition yakasarudzika. Muchadenga waitambanuka zvisingaperi, kanivhasi yemavara anochinja kubva mambakwedza kuenda kumadekwana, achiratidza runako rusingaperi rwenyika. Seagull yaitenderera pamusoro, kurira kwadzo kuchiita maungira pamusoro pemvura, zvichiwedzera mutsindo woruzha rwomugungwa. Pasinei nekusagadzikana kwegungwa, pfungwa yekunakidzwa uye kuwanikwa yakabudirira pakati pemhepo isingaperi.

Mukati mepaki yeguta iri mubishi, kuseka kwevana kwainzwika sezvavairidza maswingi nemasiraidhi. Mhuri dzakatorana magumbeze dzakatandavara pahuswa, dzichitaura nyaya uye dzichitandara pasi pemimvuri yemiti mirefu. Vamhanyi nevatyairi vemabhasikoro vaifamba munzira dzinomonereka, mafambiro avo achigadzira rhythmic kumashure kune kugadzikana kwezvisikwa mukati mehupenyu hwemudhorobha. Madhadha nemashavi aibhururuka zvakanaka pamusoro pemadziva, zvichiita kuti pave nerunyararo. Zuva parakanga rava kunopera, paki yacho yakachinja kuva nzvimbo ine runyararo umo vagari vomuguta vakawana zororo kubva mumabasa avo akabatikana.

Musoro wegomo uyu wakapa chiono chinokatyamadza chemipata yakapoteredza uye nhongonya dziri kure. Vakwikwiri vakambundirana nemoto mudiki, vachigovana ngano dzerwendo rwavo uye zviroto zvezviitiko zvenguva yemberi. Mhepo yaifefetera uye ichisimbisa, ichizadza mapapu neokisijeni yakachena, inozorodza. Masinou aibatirira pamawere ane matombo, achipenya pasi pechiedza chezuva chakajeka, achisiyana nenyika ine rima uye miti mishoma iri pasi. Sezvo makore aifamba, mimvuri yaitamba munzvimbo yose, ichisimbisa runako rwakaipa rwenzvimbo yacho. Kumira pamusoro penyika, mumwe akanzwa kubatana kwakadzama kune hukuru husingagumi hwechisikigo.

Munharaunda yakanyarara yedhorobha, mhuri dzaiita mabasa adzo nerwiyo runyoro. Vana vaitamba hopscotch mumigwagwa, kuseka kwavo kuchirira mumhepo sezvo vabereki vainyatsotarisa vari mumavharanda aiva pedyo. Magadheni akatumbuka nemhirizhonga yemavara - marozi, tulips, daisies - ese achikwikwidza kupenya kwezuva uye kutarisa. Hwema hwehuswa huchangobva kuchekwa uye maruva anotumbuka zvakagadzira mamiriro ekunze anokwezva akafukidza kukosha kwemba. Manheru akaunza kupenya kwakapfava kwemwenje yemumugwagwa uye pfungwa yekuenderera kune runyararo iyo inowanzoenda isingacherechedzwi asi inokosheswa zvakanyanya.

Matongo ekare aitaura nyaya dzebudiriro dzakapfuura kare, madziro awo ematombo akaparara asi achitsungirira. Miti yemizambiringa nemoss zvakanyura mumikaha, zvichiratidza kufamba kwenguva uye kudzoreredzwa kwezvisikwa zvezvisikwa zvevanhu. Vafambi vakadzungaira nemumigwagwa nemuzvivanze, vachifungidzira hupenyu hwaimbogara mukati mezvivakwa izvi. Runyararo rwacho rwakanga rwakadzama, rwavhiringidzwa chete nemaungira etsoka uye kuchema kure kweshiri. Sezvo zuva rakanyura kuseri kwematombo, mimvuri yakawedzera kureba, ichikanda mweya wezvakavanzika uye ruremekedzo pamusoro penzvimbo. Chakanga chiri chiyeuchidzo chokuvapo kwenguva refu kwenhau uye nhau dzakabatanidzwa mudombo riri rose.

Munhandare yenhandare yendege yakabatikana, vafambi vaipfuura vachimhanya vaine tarisiro neshungu. Mavhiri emikwende aitambamira pauriri hwakakwenenzverwa sezvo kurukurirano dzemitauro yakawanda dzaizadza mhepo. Masikirini edhijitari aipenya nguva dzekusimuka nenguva dzekusvika, zvichitungamira vafambi vasina moyo murefu kana kufara kwavanoenda. Makapu ekofi nezvikafu zvakaputira mamwe makona, humbowo hwekuchimbidza kwekudya kwemangwanani uye kugadzirira kweminiti yekupedzisira. Pakati pemhirizhonga yakarongeka, pakanga paine kunzwisisa kwakagovaniswa - nguva ipfupi yekubatana pakati pevasingazivi yakasungwa nechishuwo chakafanana chekuongorora, kudzoka, kana kutsvaga matangiro matsva. Rwendo rwakanga rwava pedyo nekuenderera mberi.

Pachitsuwa chinoyevedza, masaisai akapfava airova pamahombekombe ane jecha akachena, achikoka kuzorora uye kufungisisa. Miti yemichindwe yaizununguswa nekamhepo kemugungwa, zvimiro zvayo zvaisiyana nedenga rinoyevedza. Vaienda kumhenderekedzo yegungwa vaipisa nezuva, vakavaka majecha, uye kuunganidza magoko egungwa, vachiita mafaro ari nyore airatidza paradhiso. Pasi pemvura, matombo emakorari ane simba akazara nemavara ezvipenyu zvomugungwa, zvinoonekwa nomumvura yakachena yairatidza nyika yakavanzika inoshamisa. Sezvo manheru aiswedera, denga rakatsvuka nemavara eorenji nepingi, zvichiratidza kupera kwerimwe zuva munzvimbo iyi ine runyararo. Runako rwakadzikama rwechitsuwa ichi rwakapa nzvimbo tsvene kure neruzha rwehupenyu hwezuva nezuva.

Muchivako chehofisi chemazuva ano, vashandi vaibatirana mumakamuri emisangano akavharirwa negirazi nenzvimbo dzekushandira dzakavhurika. Kurira kwemakomputa uye kurira kwemafoni kwakagadzira ruzha rwekumashure, rwakaiswa nekudzvanya kwekiyibhodhi uye kukwenya mapepa. Dzimba dzekuputsika dzakapa nguva yekuzorora, nevamwe vaunoshanda navo vachigovana kofi uye kungotaurawo zvako. Mabhodhi machena uye masikirini airatidza machati, nguva yeprojekiti, uye mazano ari kuyerera, ese achishandira kune zvakajairika zvinangwa. Pasinei nekubatikana, pakanga paine pfungwa yechinangwa uye hutsva hwaitsanangura kutsvaga kwemazuva ano kwekufambira mberi nekubudirira.

Chiteshi chechitima chakabatikana chaishanda senzvimbo yekufambisa, uko nyaya dzisingaverengeki dzaisangana. Vafambi vakamhanya kunobata zvitima zvavo, vakabata mabhegi nemabhegi, chimwe nechimwe chine kwavaienda uye zviroto. Vatengesi vakatengesa zvekudya uye mapepanhau pamwe chete nemakaunda ematikiti achinzwika nemanzwi uye zviziviso. Chikuva chakazunguzika netarisiro sezvo injini dzaitinhira kuupenyu, zvichiratidza kuti dzaisimuka uye dzaisvika. Munzvimbo ino yenguva pfupi, nguva dzekubatana uye kuoneka dzakasangana, dzichiita maungira ehupenyu hwezuva nezuva munyika isina kumbomira kufamba.

Mukati-kati mesango, chiedza chezuva chaisefa nepamusoro pemashizha, chichikanda mapatani ane dzvuku pasi rakapfava. Zvisikwa zvemarudzi ose zvakafamba chinyararire nomunzvimbo yazvo yokugara, chimwe nechimwe chichiita basa racho mukuoma kunzwisisa kwoupenyu. Mhepo yakanga yakapfuma nokunhuhwirira kwevhu, mupaini, uye nyoro, zvichimutsa pfungwa yokugadzikana kwekare. Rukova rwakapfava rwaipfuura nemumiti, ruzha rwarwo rwuchiita senzwi rinonyevenutsa kugwenga rakanyarara. Iyi nzvimbo tsvene yakanga isati yambobatwa yakaramba iri uchapupu hwekusimba kwezvisikwa uye runako rusingagumi rwenzvimbo dzisina kumbobatwa.

Imba yekubikira yainge iine vanhu vakawanda sezvo vabiki vaibika madhiri akawanda. Manzwi anonwisa anobva kuma skillets akasanganiswa nekunhuhwirira kwemakwenzi, zvinonhuwira, uye chingwa chichangobva kubikwa, zvichigadzira nharaunda inokwezva. Mishonga yakachekwa, yakakwizwa, uye yakarungwa nemazvo, chimwe nechimwe chichibatsira mukuwirirana kwezvinonaka. Vashandi vaifamba zvisina mutsetse pakati pezviteshi, vachironga kuti ndiro yega yega yasvika pakukwana. Vaenzi vakamirira kudya kwavo, chivakwa chetarisiro apo zvisikwa zvekubika zvakaungana - ndiro yega yega ibasa reunyanzvi rakagadzirirwa kufadza manzwiro uye kugutsa mweya.

Munzvimbo yemifananidzo, madziro akashongedzwa nemuunganidzwa wakasiyana-siyana wemifananidzo, zvivezwa, uye mapikicha. Vashanyi vaifamba zvishoma nezvishoma kubva pane chimwe chikamu kuenda kune chimwe, mumwe nemumwe akamira kuti aturike uye afarire zviratidzo zvevanyori. Kuvhenekera kwakaratidza mameseji uye ruzivo, zvichiita kuti maartwork ave nehupenyu. Hurukuro dzakadzikama pamusoro pehunyanzvi, manzwiro, uye zvinoreva zvakawedzera hudzamu kune chiitiko. Nzvimbo yacho yakanga iri nzvimbo tsvene yekugadzira uye kufungisisa, apo simba rekuratidza maonero akakurudzira maonero matsva uye akakurudzira mafungiro.

Mumambakwedza padziva, mhute yaisimuka zvinyoronyoro ichibva pamusoro pemvura, ichigadzira mamiriro ekunze. Madhadha aikwasva neusimbe, achisiya manyawi, ukuwo mikonikoni yaimhanya pamusoro petsanga. Kunyarara kwemambakwedza kwakavhuniwa chete neshiri dzakapfava dzenziyo dzaitambira zuva iri. Miti yakapoteredza yairatidza mumvura yakadzikama, ichipeta kaviri pfungwa yerunyararo. Iyi nguva yerunyararo yairatidza kunaka kwakanyarara kwechisikigo nyika isati yanyatsomuka, ichitiyeuchidza nezvemitambo yerunyararo inovapo mukutenderera kwechisikigo.

Maraiti etheater akadzima sezvo keteni rakasimuka, richiratidza dariro rakarongwa remutambo usingakanganwiki. Vatambi vakapinda mumabasa avo, vachibatanidza vatambi neshungu uye nekutenda, zvichiita kuti nyaya ive mhenyu. Vateereri vakabatikana, kuseka uye kuombera maoko zvichiratidza nguva dzinobaya mwoyo uye kuchinja kunoshamisa. Mimhanzi uye mwenje zvakasimudzira manzwiro nemhepo, kushandura nzvimbo kuita nzvimbo yekufungidzira uye kushamisika. Chiitiko chacho pachakapera, kuombera maoko kwakatanga, kupemberera hunyanzvi uye kushanda nesimba izvo zvakaita kuti chiitiko ichi chive chiitiko chisingakanganwiki kune vese.

Mumisha yakanyarara, dzimba dzakamira mumitsara yakatsvinda, imwe neimwe iine bindu rayo riine maruva negirinhi. Migwagwa yakanga yakazara nezviso zvakarovedzeka uye kugutsurira kwoushamwari, kunoratidzira pfungwa yenzanga uye kugadzikana. Vana vaitamba mumayadhi asi vanhu vakuru vaiita mabasa epamba kana kuti vachikurukura pavharanda. Mhere-nyoro yehupenyu hwezuva nezuva yakagadzira mamiriro anonyaradza, achisimbisa kukosha kwemba uye kubatana. Manheru asvika, kupenya kwakapfava kwemwenje wepavharanda kwakagamuchirwa husiku, kugadzikana murunyararo rwehupenyu hwemudhorobha.

Nzira yegomo yaikwira nomunzvimbo dzakaoma, ichinetsa vafambi vane mitsetse ine mawere uye nzvimbo dzine matombo. Nhanho imwe neimwe yaida nhamburiko nokutsunga, kunotuswa nokuona kunofadza pamusangano wacho. Mhepo inotonhorera yemumakomo yaisimbisa pfungwa, nepo maruva emusango nezvinomera zvakasimba zvakanamatira kumikaha yematombo. Panhambo nenhambo, kuchema kure kure kwegondo kana kuti kuona mbudzi yomumakomo kwakayeuchidza vafambi nezvorunako rwomusango rwakavapoteredza. Kusvika pakakwirira yakanga iri nguva yokukunda, chiratidzo chokutsungirira uye simba rinotyisa rechisiko.

Musika weguta rekare waiitwa zvinhu zvakawanda, vatengesi vachishevedzera zvinhu zvavo uye vatengi vachitengeserana. Matanga akazara nezvinhu zvakagadzirwa nemaoko, zvinonhuhwirira, uye machira, chimwe nechimwe chaimiririra chikamu chenhaka yeguta yakapfuma. Kunhuhwirira kwezvokudya zvekunze kwakazadza mhepo, kuchiedza vaipfuura kuti vaone zvimwe zvinonaka. Ruzha rwemimhanzi uye kutamba kubva kune vaimbi vari pedyo zvakawedzera kumhepo inofadza. Iyi nzvimbo yakabatikana yakanga inopfuura nzvimbowo zvayo yokutengesera; yakanga iri mharadzano yenhau, tsika, uye kubatana kwavanhu.

Pasi pedenga rehusiku, moto wemusasa waipenya unokanda mimvuri yekutamba pazviso zvevafambi vaneta. Vachikurukura nyaya uye vachiimba nziyo, vakafara nomufaro wokushamwaridzana. Mwoto waivhuvhuta waipa kudziya mumhepo inotonhorera, nepo nyeredzi dziri pamusoro dzakagovera kanivhasi yomudenga yechishamiso chisingagumi. Kurira kure kure kwezizi uye kutinhira kunyoro kwemashizha zvakagadzira mamiriro ezvinhu anozorodza. Munguva ino, yakakomberedzwa nemasikirwo uye shamwari, nguva yakaita seyakamira, ichisimbisa kukwezva kusingagumi kwezviitiko zvekunze.

Musangano wezvidzidzo wakaunza pamwechete nyanzvi kubva pasirese kuti vagovane mazano uye vakurukure mabhindauko matsva. Vakurukuri vakuru vakapa hurukuro dzinokurudzira, vachibatidza mitsetse mitsva yekubvunza uye kubatana. Zvirongwa zvebreakout zvaikurudzira nhaurirano inodyidzana, ichikurudzira nharaunda yepfungwa dzinoda kuziva. Kutsinhana kwezivo kwakawedzerwa nekubatanidza zviitiko uye zviitiko zvetsika, zvichipfumisa ruzivo kupfuura dzidzo. Sezvo musangano wakapera, vatori vechikamu vakaendesa mberi maonero matsva uye kudyidzana kunogona kuitika, zvichikurudzira kufambira mberi mundima dzavo.

Mvura yakanaya zvinyoro-nyoro muguta, zvichiita kuti pave nokuridza mutinhimira pamahwindo nepamusoro pedzimba. Vanofamba netsoka vaimhanya vari pasi pemaamburera, nhanho dzavo dzaimhanya-mhanya asi vasingamhanyi-mhanyi, sezvo mirau yaipenya pamugwagwa wakanyorova. Kunhuhwirira kwepasi rakanyorova nemvura yakachena kwakasimbisa pfungwa, zvichipa nguva yekuvandudzwa mukati mehupenyu hwemudhorobha. Maraiti emumugwagwa anopenya kupenya kwegoridhe, zvichipesana nedenga regrey rinotonhorera, zvichiwedzera kudziya kwenzvimbo. Kusununguka uye kudzikama zvakatsiva mheremhere yapfuura, guta richimbundikira mvura inonyevenutsa, ichiyeuchidza munhu wese nezvesimba rakapfava rechisiko.

Temberi yekare yakamira seuchapupu kuhunyanzvi hwemunhu uye zvemweya, madziro ayo ematombo akashongedzwa nemazana emakore emhepo nemamiriro ekunze. Zvivezwa zvakaoma kunzwisisa nezvidhori zvakashongedza mativi ayo apamberi, achizevezera nhau dzokuzvipira nengano. Vafambi nevashanyi zvakafanana vakawana nyaradzo uye kurudziro mukati menzvimbo dzayo dzakagadzikana, umo kunyarara nekuremekedza kwakazadza mhepo. Kuvapo kwetemberi kwaibatanidza nguva yakapfuura neyazvino, ichibatira sechiyeuchidzo chitsvene chenhaka yetsika uye kutsvaka zvinogara zvichireva chinangwa. Sezvo chiedza chezuva chaipinda nepakati nepakatsemuka, pfungwa yekusashanda yakafukidza nzvimbo yacho.

Carnival yacho yainakidza yairatidza ruvara, ruzha, uye mafaro. Makwikwi aimhanya-mhanya uye akakwira, akazara nekushevedzera kwemufaro, nepo zvitoro zvemitambo zvaipa mukana wemibairo nekuseka. Vaimbi vakapfeka zvipfeko vaivaraidza mhomho yevanhu vachiita zvemashiripiti, mashiripiti, uye mitambo yemimhanzi, zvichitora fungidziro yemazera ese. Kunhuhwirira kwemaswiti edonje, popcorn, uye masoseji akagochwa aikwezvera vaiuya kuti vafarire. Husiku hwacho hwava, mwenje unopenya nemimhanzi zvakagadzira mhepo ine simba yaipemberera mufaro, nharaunda, uye mafaro ari nyore ehupenyu.

Mukona yeraibhurari yakanyarara, dhesiki rimwe chete raivhenekerwa nerambi, richikoka muverengi kuti azvirasikire mubhuku. Mapeji aya aibata nyika dzekunakidzwa, ruzivo, uye manzwiro, rimwe nerimwe musuwo wekunzwisisa kutsva kana kutiza. Kunyarara kwepakati kwakasimudzira pfungwa nekufungisisa, nzvimbo tsvene kubva mumhirizhonga kunze. Pedyo, masherufu akarongwa nemusoro wenyaya uye nemunyori akapa rondedzero yakawanda yemafungiro evanhu uye unyanzvi. Iyi nzvimbo yekuda kuziva yakaratidza simba risingaperi rekuverenga kukurudzira, kudzidzisa, uye kushandura.

Munda wemizambiringa wakanga wakatandavara pamusoro pezvikomo; Vashandi vaifamba zvine mwero pakati pemitsara, vachichekerera nekunhonga, mumwe nemumwe achitarisira ivhu nehungwaru uye nehunyanzvi. Zuva rakaisa ruvara rwegoridhe pamusoro penzvimbo yakasvibira, richisimbisa girinhi inoyevedza uye yepepuru yakadzika. Mhepo yakazadzwa nekunhuhwirira kwakanaka kwemuchero nevhu, kunosanganisira kukosha kwehupenyu hwekurima. Sezvo mwaka wekukohwa waiswedera, tarisiro yakakura yewaini yakanga ichiri kugadzirwa kubva mumasumbu anokosha aya.

Taundi rakafukidzwa nesinou rakanga riri chiono-chakanaka chechando, chine matenga edzimba akafukidzwa nemicheka michena nechando chakarembera pamizevedzo. Migwagwa yakanga yakanyarara, yakavharwa nokudonha kwechando zvinyoronyoro, zvichiita kuti pave nerunyararo. Vana vakavaka varume vechando uye vairwa nechando, kuseka kwavo kuchirira mumhepo inotonhorera. Mwenje dzinodziya dzemudzimba nemashopu dzaisiyana zvakanaka nenzvimbo yaitonhora, zvichiita kuti vanhu vanzwe kufara. Nzvimbo yose yaiita seyaipenya nemashiripiti emwaka wacho, ichikoka vose kuti vagamuchire runyararo rwenguva yechando.

Muguta rine chiteshi chezvikepe rine vanhu vakawanda, ngarava dzinotakura zvinhu uye zvikepe zvokuredzesa zvakanyura muchiteshi chezvikepe, matanda azvo achikwira mudenga.
